# Requirement_ID: Unique identifier from requirements documents (54-00-03-XX-NNN)
# Requirement_Title: Short title of the requirement
#   - Functional: What the system must do
#   - Performance: How well the system must perform
#   - Interface: How the system connects with others
# Status: Current status of the requirement
# Parent_Requirement: ID of parent requirement if this is derived (N/A if top-level)
# Design_Element_ID: ID of the design element that satisfies this requirement
# Design_Element_Title: Name/title of the design element
# Verification_Method: How requirement compliance is verified
# Test_Procedure_ID: Reference to test procedure document (N/A if not applicable)
# Safety_Impact: Failure effect classification per ARP4761/CS-25
#   - Hazardous: Large reduction in safety margins
#   - Catastrophic: Multiple fatalities or loss of aircraft
